description: Sends the same prompt to multiple LLM providers in parallel and returns a divergence score (0.0 = identical meaning, 1.0 = maximally divergent) plus each provider's response. Refusals are excluded from scoring. Requires API keys set as environment variables (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY) for whichever providers are requested.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to all requested providers

name: compare
title: Compare LLM responses for divergence
